system: One designated blank single-head output tape of a deterministic finite-alphabet multitape SAT-witness emitter, after source witness is fully constructed
scope: post-authentication explicit sparse witness bit-record emission, NOT an arbitrary binary SAT decision lower bound
state: full program/control, input and work tape contents/heads, paid transition history, output tape symbol vector and head, definitions and interfaces, unresolved output goal, halt flag
cost: Every physical TM step cost 1; no zero-cost primitive transitions
potential: number of blank cells among B mandatory output record cells
1 if emission incomplete and machine active, else 0
goal: All B designated output cells nonblank with correct explicit record and successful HALT; p_interface=p_machine=0
completeness: Every physical step writes at most one cell of the single designated output tape; its signed delta_interface lies in {-1,0,1}. Halt changes flag at most once. Some conservative combinations are not goal-reaching but are preserved as MAY.
exactCone: lambda_interface>=0, lambda_machine>=0, lambda_interface+lambda_machine<=1 (other five weights set 0)
dual: Dual multiplier y=B on fused constraint proves maximum B for objective B*lambda_interface+lambda_machine

resourceLedger.logicalWork: pairing/selection/witness computation occurs before this emission phase and is separately charged
resourceLedger.elapsedSequentialTime: one per native step, output stage >= B
resourceLedger.parallelSpan: not derived from sequential output bound; multiple output heads require a separate model
resourceLedger.evidenceBits: B exact explicit sparse variable-value bit records
resourceLedger.retention: up to B output cells plus precomputed witness storage
resourceLedger.retrievalRecomputation: all head moves and recomputation remain paid, do not decrease this blank-cell obstruction
resourceLedger.peakWritableSpace: B visited output cells plus any prior algorithm workspace; not identical to time

hostile: last bit write and HALT in one step (forces sum<=1)
no operation has zero physical cost
one output tape only, no parallel multihead assumption
decision-only SAT accepts with one-bit label; no output-B lower bound transfer
